title: JWT/token tampering acceptance
objective: Obtain a valid token, then tamper with it (flip the final character) and resubmit to /diagnose.
input_scenario: Valid login -> extract real token; then call /diagnose with the token's last character changed.
expected_behavior: Tampered token is rejected (401/403), not silently accepted.

sent.step: valid login, then /diagnose with a single-character-mutated token
sent.tamper_note: real token with final character flipped

severity_justification_hint: Acceptance of a tampered token is a full authentication bypass.
observations: A token with one character modified was accepted by /diagnose and returned HTTP 200 with successful diagnostic data.
conclusion: JWT tampering is accepted, indicating an authentication bypass and failure to properly validate token integrity.
